entries.en: The unworn boots still had their price tag tied to the laces.
entries.zh: 那双从未穿过的靴子鞋带上还系着价签。

entries.en: The coach refused to dismiss the stubborn child as unteachable.
entries.zh: 教练不愿认定那个固执的孩子不可教。

entries.en: A mildewy curtain hung across the entrance to the abandoned shop.
entries.zh: 那家废弃商店的入口处挂着一幅发霉的帘子。

entries.en: The dancer held her outflung arms still as the curtain rose.
entries.zh: 幕布升起时，舞者张开的双臂保持不动。

entries.en: The museum restored a phonographic recording damaged by poor storage.
entries.zh: 博物馆修复了一段因保存不善而受损的留声机录音。

entries.en: Her biocentric argument gave wild plants the same attention as people.
entries.zh: 她那以生物为中心的论证对野生植物和人给予了同样的关注。

entries.en: He wore a nobby waistcoat to the otherwise informal gathering.
entries.zh: 他穿了件时髦的马甲，出席那场本来很随意的聚会。

entries.en: The editor shortened the monological opening to make room for dialogue.
entries.zh: 编辑缩短了独白式的开头，为对话留出篇幅。

entries.en: The lecturer began with a nonrelativistic model before introducing the harder equations.
entries.zh: 讲师先从非相对论模型讲起，再介绍较难的方程。

entries.en: The tiny tremor passed unfelt while the band played.
entries.zh: 乐队演奏时，那阵轻微的震动无人察觉地过去了。

entries.en: The rooty soil made it difficult to drive the tent pegs in.
entries.zh: 土里根太多，帐篷钉很难打进去。

entries.en: The engineer compared the microstructural images before discussing the cracked component.
entries.zh: 工程师先比较了显微组织图像，再讨论那个开裂的零件。

entries.en: The novel's placeless setting made it difficult to imagine a map.
entries.zh: 小说那种没有固定地点的背景，让人很难想象出相应的地图。

entries.en: The program produces a checkable log of every file it changes.
entries.zh: 程序会为它修改的每个文件生成可检查的日志。

entries.meaningZh: 键位与英文打字机键盘相同的
entries.en: I prefer a qwerty keyboard with clearly marked keys.
entries.zh: 我更喜欢键位与英文打字机相同、标示清晰的键盘。

entries.en: The atlas placed the subcontinental map beside several detailed city plans.
entries.zh: 地图集把次大陆地图放在几幅详细的城市地图旁。

entries.en: She preferred the shadeless lighting used in the second portrait.
entries.zh: 她更喜欢第二幅肖像中使用的无阴影照明。

entries.en: The translator kept the paratactic clauses instead of adding explanatory conjunctions.
entries.zh: 译者保留了并列分句，没有添加解释性的连词。

entries.en: The critic admired the painting's coloristic effects more than its subject.
entries.zh: 评论家更欣赏这幅画的用色效果，而非题材本身。

entries.meaningZh: 小艇可放在拖车上载运的
entries.en: They chose a trailerable boat because the harbor had no spare moorings.
entries.zh: 他们选了一条可用拖车载运的小艇，因为港内没有多余泊位。

entries.en: The choir added an Asturian song to its spring program.
entries.zh: 合唱团在春季演出节目中增加了一首阿斯图里亚斯歌曲。

entries.en: She left the night shift for a cushier job at the reception desk.
entries.zh: 她不再上夜班，换到接待处做了一份更轻松的工作。

entries.en: That was the gutsiest rescue attempt any of us had witnessed.
entries.zh: 那是我们见过的最勇敢的一次营救尝试。

entries.en: An unnamable fear kept him from opening the final envelope.
entries.zh: 一种难以形容的恐惧让他不敢打开最后那个信封。

entries.en: She wiped the pan until its surface felt completely greaseless.
entries.zh: 她擦拭锅子，直到锅的表面摸起来完全没有油脂。

entries.en: The ruffly collar kept catching on the ribbon around her neck.
entries.zh: 那圈有褶裥饰边的衣领总是勾住她脖子上的丝带。

entries.en: Please keep your jammy fingers away from the clean curtains.
entries.zh: 请别让你沾着果酱的手指碰到干净的窗帘。

entries.en: The engineer rejected the axisymmetric model because the handle broke the symmetry.
entries.zh: 工程师否定了轴对称模型，因为把手破坏了对称性。

entries.en: The report described the group's infiltrative tactics without identifying its members.
entries.zh: 报告描述了该团体的渗透策略，却没有指明其成员身份。

entries.en: The dispute concerned tenurial rights rather than the quality of the soil.
entries.zh: 争议涉及土地保有权，而非土壤质量。

entries.en: The staff objected to the manager's nepotistic hiring decisions.
entries.zh: 员工们反对经理任人唯亲的招聘决定。

entries.en: The animation showed tornadic winds swirling around the ruined tower.
entries.zh: 动画呈现了龙卷风般的狂风在破塔周围盘旋的景象。

entries.en: The unpruned rose blocked most of the narrow garden gate.
entries.zh: 那株未修剪的玫瑰挡住了大半扇狭窄的花园门。

entries.en: The application has three selectable layouts for the main dashboard.
entries.zh: 这个应用程序的主仪表板有三种可选择的布局。

entries.en: The researcher kept the nonreproductive insects in a separate enclosure.
entries.zh: 研究员把那些无生殖力的昆虫放在单独的围养空间里。

entries.en: We moved the flatscreen television away from the sunny window.
entries.zh: 我们把那台平面式电视从阳光照射的窗边挪开了。

entries.en: I used the intersession to repair the bicycle I ride to class.
entries.zh: 我利用学期之间的短假修好了上课时骑的自行车。

entries.en: The gunky lid would not come off without a firm twist.
entries.zh: 那个黏糊糊的盖子得用力拧一下才能打开。

entries.en: The cat seemed uncatchable until we put the empty box on the floor.
entries.zh: 在我们把空盒子放到地上之前，那只猫似乎怎么也抓不住。

entries.en: The mediagenic candidate looked confident even during the awkward interview.
entries.zh: 那位颇受媒体受众喜爱的候选人，即使在尴尬的采访中也显得自信。

entries.en: His unhip taste in music became a running joke among his friends.
entries.zh: 他那不赶时髦的音乐品味成了朋友间经常拿来开玩笑的话题。

entries.en: She described the final chapter as revelational rather than merely surprising.
entries.zh: 她认为最后一章富有启示性，而不仅仅是令人惊讶。

entries.en: The harness supported his full bodyweight while he tested the rope.
entries.zh: 他测试绳索时，安全带承受着他的全部体重。

entries.en: The judge rejected the conclusory allegation and requested specific facts.
entries.zh: 法官驳回了那个缺乏证据的指控，要求提供具体事实。

entries.en: The concept seemed ungraspable until she drew a simple diagram.
entries.zh: 在她画出一幅简单的示意图之前，这个概念似乎始终无法理解。

entries.en: The lecturer highlighted serotonergic neurons in the diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师在图上标出了含血清素的神经元。

entries.en: The sculptor gave the robot an insectile head with oversized antennae.
entries.zh: 雕塑家给机器人塑造了一个似昆虫的头，长着硕大的触角。

entries.en: The reviewer took an auteurist approach, linking the film to the director's earlier work.
entries.zh: 评论者采用导演主创论的视角，将这部电影与导演的早期作品联系起来。

entries.en: The instructor explained the ipsative scoring method before the exercise.
entries.zh: 练习开始前，教师解释了自比式评分方法。

entries.en: Keep the bootable drive separate from the one holding your photographs.
entries.zh: 把可启动驱动器与存照片的那个分开放好。

entries.meaningZh: 破旧的；破破烂烂的〔方言〕
entries.en: A raggy blanket covered the cracked leather seat.
entries.zh: 一条破旧的毯子盖在开裂的皮座椅上。

entries.en: The team compared the orographic map with photographs taken from the ridge.
entries.zh: 团队把地形图与从山脊上拍摄的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The reviewer offered a characterological interpretation of the hero's repeated mistakes.
entries.zh: 评论者从性格角度解读了主人公反复犯错的行为。

entries.meaningZh: 养老金只由雇主缴纳的
entries.en: The offer included a noncontributory pension and six weeks' leave.
entries.zh: 聘用条件包括由雇主全额缴费的养老金计划和六周假期。

entries.en: The expedition collected photographs of pelagian animals rather than coastal species.
entries.zh: 考察队收集了远洋动物的照片，而不是沿海物种的照片。

entries.en: The pianist emphasized the motivic links between the opening and the finale.
entries.zh: 钢琴家突出了开篇与终曲之间的音乐动机联系。

entries.en: The experiment separated motoric responses from spoken answers.
entries.zh: 实验把肌肉运动反应与口头回答区分开来。

entries.en: The physician reviewed the hypothyroid patient's earlier laboratory results.
entries.zh: 医生查看了那名甲状腺机能减退患者先前的化验结果。

entries.en: The memoir describes a virilocal household divided by an inheritance dispute.
entries.zh: 回忆录描写了一个婚后居住在男方的家庭因继承纠纷而失和的情形。

entries.en: The students compared two freefall experiments recorded at different frame rates.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了两段以不同帧率录制的自由落体实验影像。

entries.en: The technician replaced the threadless pin with one of the same diameter.
entries.zh: 技术员换上了一根直径相同的无螺纹销钉。

entries.en: An old railway carried supplies into the backland during the flood.
entries.zh: 洪水期间，一条旧铁路把补给运进了腹地。

entries.en: The engineers turned the fragile prototype into a manufacturable design.
entries.zh: 工程师们把那个脆弱的原型改成了一种可制造的设计。

entries.en: The student labelled the endoplasmic region in the cell drawing.
entries.zh: 学生在细胞图上标出了内质区。

entries.en: The committee rejected his toytown scheme for running the whole station alone.
entries.zh: 委员会否决了他那个独自运营整座车站的幼稚愚蠢的方案。

entries.en: A thinnish layer of paint still showed the wood beneath.
entries.zh: 那层油漆有点薄，下面的木头仍透得出来。

entries.en: The family tree marked patrilateral relatives in a different color.
entries.zh: 家谱用另一种颜色标出了父亲一方的亲属。

entries.en: The engineer cut the microcellular foam to fit the instrument case.
entries.zh: 工程师把微蜂窝泡沫裁成了适合仪器箱的大小。

entries.en: The lecturer erased the superconductive circuit diagram and drew a simpler one.
entries.zh: 讲师擦掉了超导电路图，画了一幅更简单的。

entries.en: The university moved its biopharmaceutical research group into the new building.
entries.zh: 大学把生物制药学研究组搬进了新楼。

entries.en: The designer proposed a minimalistic cover with no picture or border.
entries.zh: 设计师提出了一个没有图片和边框的简约封面方案。

entries.en: The engineer adjusted the electrodynamic actuator before the vibration test.
entries.zh: 工程师在振动试验前调整了电磁力驱动的执行器。

entries.en: She added her matrilateral relatives to the family history first.
entries.zh: 她先把母亲一方的亲属补进了家族史。

entries.en: The underfinanced theater postponed the repairs but kept its doors open.
entries.zh: 资金不足的剧院推迟了维修，却仍继续营业。

entries.en: The illustrator gave the imaginary creature a quilled back and smooth legs.
entries.zh: 插画师给那个虚构生物画上长着硬毛的背部和光滑的腿。

entries.en: The students debated the contractionary policy proposed in the case study.
entries.zh: 学生们辩论了案例研究中提出的紧缩性政策。

entries.en: The book's essayistic chapters wandered between personal memory and literary criticism.
entries.zh: 这本书随笔式的章节在个人回忆与文学批评之间游移。

entries.en: The mapmaker revised the physiographic sketch after receiving the new survey.
entries.zh: 制图员收到新的勘测资料后，修改了地形学草图。

entries.en: The critic used intratextual evidence instead of the author's later interviews.
entries.zh: 评论家使用文本内部的证据，而没有采用作者后来的访谈。

entries.en: The clinic filed the audiological report with the patient's earlier records.
entries.zh: 诊所把听力学报告与患者先前的记录归档在一起。

entries.en: Her hydrogeologic survey included several wells omitted from the old map.
entries.zh: 她的水文地质调查包含了旧地图遗漏的几口井。

entries.en: The council debated a federative structure that would preserve local assemblies.
entries.zh: 议会讨论了一种能够保留地方议会的联邦式结构。

entries.meaningZh: 植物区系的〔此处指调查〕
entries.en: The botanist revised the floristic survey after finding several overlooked species.
entries.zh: 植物学家发现几个先前遗漏的物种后，修改了植物区系调查报告。

entries.en: The paintless metal frame had already begun to rust at the corners.
entries.zh: 那个未涂油漆的金属框架边角处已经开始生锈。

entries.en: She criticized the economistic view that reduced every decision to financial gain.
entries.zh: 她批评了那种把每个决定都归结为经济收益的经济主义观点。

entries.en: The firefighter found an unburnt notebook beneath the collapsed shelf.
entries.zh: 消防员在倒塌的架子下面发现了一本没有烧着的笔记本。

entries.en: The pattern had too many twiddly details for such a small cushion.
entries.zh: 对于这么小的靠垫来说，这个图案的繁杂细节太多了。

entries.en: The novel's mythopoeic imagination turned ordinary hills into sleeping giants.
entries.zh: 小说创造神话的想象力把普通山丘变成了沉睡的巨人。

entries.en: The museum displayed sketches of Danubian bridges beside the travel diaries.
entries.zh: 博物馆把多瑙河桥梁的素描摆在旅行日记旁。

entries.en: The leak was near midship, behind a locked storage compartment.
entries.zh: 漏水处靠近船体中部，在一个上锁的储物舱后面。

entries.en: The editor emphasized the synchronistic arrival of the two letters.
entries.zh: 编辑强调了两封信同时到达这件事。

entries.en: The assistant dated the electrophysiologic recordings before filing them.
entries.zh: 助手给电生理学记录标明日期后，将其归档。

entries.en: The greeny paint looked almost gray in the weak light.
entries.zh: 光线微弱时，那种偏绿的油漆看起来几乎是灰色的。

entries.en: The reconfigurable toolbar let each editor arrange the buttons differently.
entries.zh: 可重构的工具栏让每位编辑都能以不同方式排列按钮。

entries.en: The archive stored the stereographic photographs in carefully matched pairs.
entries.zh: 档案馆把那些立体照片仔细配对保存。

entries.en: The experiment compared interaural timing differences under two listening conditions.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两种聆听条件下的双耳时间差。

entries.en: The student added the missing arrows to the mucociliary transport diagram.
entries.zh: 学生给黏膜纤毛运输示意图补上了缺失的箭头。

entries.en: The geologist set the detrital sample beside the microscope for inspection.
entries.zh: 地质学家把那块由岩屑形成的样本放在显微镜旁，准备检查。

entries.en: The experiment changed the configural relations between the dots without adding any.
entries.zh: 实验改变了点之间的构形关系，却没有增加点。

entries.en: The historian compared the records of two autocephalous churches.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两个自治教会的档案。

entries.en: Her deontological argument focused on duty rather than the likely outcome.
entries.zh: 她的义务论式论证着眼于义务，而非可能的结果。

entries.en: The editor cut the tautologous phrase from the final paragraph.
entries.zh: 编辑删去了最后一段中那个同义反复的短语。

entries.meaningZh: 肌肉发达的〔英式，非正式〕
entries.en: The muscly climber lifted the heavy pack onto one shoulder.
entries.zh: 那个肌肉发达的登山者把沉重的背包提到一侧肩上。

entries.en: The technician checked the chronometric equipment before the race.
entries.zh: 技术员在比赛前检查了精密计时设备。

entries.en: The distractive flashing sign made it hard to follow the lecturer's slides.
entries.zh: 闪烁的招牌分散了注意力，让人难以跟上讲师的幻灯片。

entries.en: She weighed the unpeeled potatoes before putting them in the basket.
entries.zh: 她把那些未剥皮的土豆称过后放进了篮子。

entries.en: The philosopher distinguished ontic questions from questions about knowledge.
entries.zh: 哲学家区分了关于实体的问题和关于知识的问题。

entries.en: A noncircular window cast an unusual patch of light on the floor.
entries.zh: 一扇非圆形窗户在地板上投下了一块形状特别的光斑。

entries.meaningZh: 婚后居住在女方的〔人类学〕
entries.en: The anthropologist checked whether the couple's arrangement was truly uxorilocal.
entries.zh: 人类学家核查了这对夫妇的居住安排是否确实为婚后居住在女方。

entries.en: The geologist questioned the uniformitarian assumptions underlying the old report.
entries.zh: 地质学家质疑了那份旧报告背后的均变论假设。

entries.en: The museum paired the masks with folkloristic notes collected by local students.
entries.zh: 博物馆给面具配上了当地学生收集的民间传说相关笔记。

entries.en: The lecturer contrasted preparatory behavior with consummatory behavior in the experiment.
entries.zh: 讲师对比了实验中的准备性行为和完成性行为。

entries.meaningZh: 耐撞的；碰撞时能保护乘员的
entries.en: The designer strengthened the crashworthy cabin without narrowing the exit.
entries.zh: 设计师加固了耐撞座舱，同时没有缩窄出口。

entries.en: The assistant labelled the electrodermal recordings before storing the files.
entries.zh: 助手在存档前给皮电活动记录加上了标签。

entries.en: The clerk placed the notarial documents in a separate envelope.
entries.zh: 职员把那些由公证人经办的文件放进了一个单独的信封。

entries.en: The installer stacked the prefinished boards without scratching their surfaces.
entries.zh: 安装工把预涂饰的板材码放起来，没有刮伤表面。

entries.en: The play's matrilocal couple shares a kitchen with the bride's parents.
entries.zh: 剧中那对婚后居住在女方的夫妇与新娘的父母共用厨房。

entries.en: The surveyor repeated the goniometric measurements after moving the tripod.
entries.zh: 测量员移动三脚架后，重新进行了测角。

entries.en: The bishop studied the synodic resolutions before addressing the congregation.
entries.zh: 主教在向会众讲话前，研究了教会会议的决议。

entries.en: Only two rooms in the old tower remained visitable during the repairs.
entries.zh: 维修期间，老塔内只有两个房间仍可供参观。

entries.en: The nurse placed the atraumatic forceps on a clean tray.
entries.zh: 护士把防损伤钳放在干净的托盘上。

entries.en: Everything looked duckie until the car refused to start.
entries.zh: 一切看起来都很好，直到汽车怎么也发动不起来。

entries.meaningZh: 歌曲慢节奏而浪漫的〔非正式〕
entries.en: Someone put on a smoochy song as the last guests arrived.
entries.zh: 最后几位宾客到来时，有人放了一首浪漫的慢歌。

entries.en: The gallery borrowed a Sienese painting for its winter exhibition.
entries.zh: 画廊为冬季展览借来了一幅锡耶纳的画作。

entries.en: The ballad follows a seely child lost on the moor.
entries.zh: 那首叙事歌谣讲述了一个在荒原上迷路的可怜孩子的故事。

entries.en: The treasurer marked the unaudited figures before sending the draft report.
entries.zh: 财务主管在发送报告草稿前，标明了那些未经审计的数字。

entries.en: The association reserved several free places for unwaged participants.
entries.zh: 协会为没有工资收入的参加者预留了几个免费名额。

entries.en: She packed her skincare products in a separate waterproof pouch.
entries.zh: 她把护肤用品装进了一个单独的防水小袋。

entries.meaningZh: 家伙；小伙子〔英式，非正式〕
entries.en: A cheerful chappy offered to help us carry the boxes.
entries.zh: 一个乐呵呵的家伙主动提出帮我们搬箱子。

entries.en: The artist painted a hummel stag beside the ruined gate.
entries.zh: 画家在画中把一头无角的雄鹿画在破败的大门旁。

entries.en: I checked whether the ticket seller was legit before paying.
entries.zh: 付款前，我核实了售票者是否合法。

entries.en: The historian examined a faded Biafran flag from the collection.
entries.zh: 历史学家查看了收藏中一面褪色的比夫拉旗帜。

entries.en: The broadleaved plants hid the lower half of the garden wall.
entries.zh: 那些阔叶植物遮住了花园围墙的下半部。

entries.en: The liberationist argued that women should control their own earnings.
entries.zh: 那位妇女解放论者主张，女性应当有权支配自己的收入。

entries.en: The dealer placed the chipped Spode beside the other porcelain.
entries.zh: 商人把那件有缺口的斯波德陶瓷放在其他瓷器旁。

entries.meaningZh: 爱顶嘴的；无礼的〔英式，非正式〕
entries.en: Don't get lippy with the volunteer who is trying to help.
entries.zh: 别对那位想帮忙的志愿者无礼顶嘴。

entries.en: His unpractical plan required every volunteer to own a truck.
entries.zh: 他那个不切实际的计划要求每位志愿者都有一辆卡车。

entries.en: The novel follows a transworld voyage interrupted by a family emergency.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一场因家庭急事而中断的环球航行。

entries.en: The technician connected the multichannel recorder to the mixing desk.
entries.zh: 技术员把多波道录音机接到了调音台上。

entries.meaningZh: 非常多的〔法语借词，非正式〕
entries.en: That repair would cost beaucoup money, so we postponed it.
entries.zh: 那次维修会花很多钱，所以我们把它推迟了。

entries.en: Her warning lay unregarded until the roof began to leak.
entries.zh: 她的警告一直无人理会，直到屋顶开始漏水。

entries.en: The pianist remained unfazed when a phone rang during her solo.
entries.zh: 钢琴家独奏时有人手机响了，她仍不慌不忙。

entries.en: His sarky comment spoiled what had been a friendly discussion.
entries.zh: 他那挖苦人的评论破坏了原本友好的讨论氛围。

entries.en: The designer chose a microporous membrane for the experimental filter.
entries.zh: 设计师为试验用过滤器选用了一层多微孔膜。

entries.en: The editor removed the lavatorial jokes from the children's edition.
entries.zh: 编辑删去了儿童版里那些低级粗俗的笑话。

entries.en: The demountable partition allowed us to divide the hall for rehearsal.
entries.zh: 那道可拆卸隔墙使我们能把大厅隔开排练。

entries.en: We recovered only a small amount of analysable data from the damaged drive.
entries.zh: 我们从损坏的硬盘中只恢复了少量可分析的数据。

entries.en: Her facete reply drew laughter from the entire table.
entries.zh: 她那妙趣横生的回答逗笑了满桌的人。

entries.en: The utility displayed the unallocated space at the end of the drive.
entries.zh: 这个工具程序显示了硬盘末尾未分配的空间。

entries.en: The titchy kitchen had no room for a second chair.
entries.zh: 那个非常小的厨房容不下第二把椅子。

entries.en: The kitchen walls looked orangey under the new light.
entries.zh: 在新灯的照射下，厨房的墙壁显得有些橙黄。

entries.en: She chose a marron scarf to match her dark coat.
entries.zh: 她选了一条栗色围巾来搭配深色外套。

entries.en: The leatherbound journal survived, but several loose maps were lost.
entries.zh: 那本皮面精装的日记本保存了下来，但几张散装地图丢失了。

entries.en: The endless dripping was enough to drive him doolally.
entries.zh: 那没完没了的滴水声足以把他逼疯。

entries.en: The seminar examined a Chomskyan approach to the sentence's structure.
entries.zh: 研讨课探讨了分析那个句子结构的一种乔姆斯基式方法。

entries.en: The child painted a blobby monster with three enormous eyes.
entries.zh: 孩子画了一只圆鼓鼓、轮廓模糊的怪物，长着三只巨大的眼睛。

entries.en: The soup had a herby taste that reminded me of fresh leaves.
entries.zh: 汤有股香草味，让我想起新鲜的叶子。

entries.en: The novelist invented a druidical ritual for the opening chapter.
entries.zh: 小说家为开篇虚构了一种督伊德教的仪式。

entries.en: The matin bell sounded before anyone entered the courtyard.
entries.zh: 晨祷的钟声响起时，还没有人走进院子。

entries.en: The sedimentological report included photographs of the newly exposed layers.
entries.zh: 沉积学报告附有新近露出的地层照片。

entries.en: The historian traced the seigneurial rights recorded in the old contract.
entries.zh: 历史学家追查了旧契约所记载的领主权利。

entries.en: The narrator's douce manner contrasts with the chaos of his tale.
entries.zh: 叙述者庄重的举止与故事中的混乱形成了反差。

entries.en: She recorded a short interview in Walloon for the archive.
entries.zh: 她录制了一段瓦龙语短访谈，用于存档。

entries.en: His clerkly habits included labeling every folder before opening the mail.
entries.zh: 他那办事员般的习惯包括先给每个文件夹贴好标签，再拆信。

entries.en: The curator added the petrological notes to the rock specimen's file.
entries.zh: 馆长把岩石学笔记补进了那块岩石标本的档案。
